verdict.rationale: The pack does not document any way for a user to mint API credentials for an agent that are restricted to specific tools, scopes or permissions. The REST APIs use generic OAuth 2 access tokens, and the remote MCP server only advertises openid/email/profile scopes rather than per-API least-privilege scopes. The single-use delegated payment tokens with amount and time limits are buyer payment credentials passed to merchants, an adjacent feature rather than scoped API credentials issued for an agent.
